name: Shatter
description: Level 2 Evocation (Bard, Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S, M (a chip of mica) Duration: Instantaneous A loud noise erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Resolve saving throw, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has Disadvantage on the save. A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.
